prospective_distance_constraint.note: prospective constraint on the CONTROL pool only; NEVER references d_auth. Disabled by default; enable in a frozen declaration to run the distance-matched variant.

primary_family_rationale: distant_source_word_mapping is the corrected primary control: for target W, control = a DIFFERENT real source word W′'s OWN complete authentic varṇa-derived facet aggregate, where W′ is selected as semantically distant from W using target/context embeddings ONLY (never facet embeddings or outcome distances) and the W->W′ assignment is frozen before the endpoint. This keeps the control on the same varṇa-mapping construction and register as authentic (unlike the out-of-pool lexicon, which is a different register), while guaranteeing the source word is genuinely distant (unlike within-pool derangements, which are paraphrase-level near-synonyms). out_of_pool_lexicon_facet is retained as a SECONDARY external-register control; the within-pool families are retained for triangulation.
note: same_polarity requires poles (resolver) -> BLOCKED under resolver-free named_attribute mode; frequency portion unavailable -> length_only. distant_source_word_mapping W′ pool = the frozen B1.9 target set; W→W′ frozen from target/context distance only. out_of_pool_lexicon_facet content comes from the frozen b1_9_out_of_pool_lexicon.json and reuses NO varṇa mapping.
